title: PolicyDecision
description: The policy engine's answer. Release 1 runs in observe mode: nothing is enforced yet (the gateway is not built), so enforced is always false and wouldBlock says what enforcement would do.

wouldBlock.description: Whether enforcement would block this: a denial, unless the denying ActionPolicy is in monitor mode.

monitored.description: A monitor rule matched, or a monitor-mode policy denied: the request is flagged for review.

policyMode.description: action: the mode of the ActionPolicy for the agent, if one exists.

matchedRules.description: The rules that decided: the allowing ones for an allow, the denying ones for a deny. Empty for a denial by default.

checked.description: The parts of the effective permission that were evaluated.

notEvaluated.description: Parts of the effective permission that release 1 cannot evaluate yet.
